svg.text: Threshold renewal: pull toward the open room, then lift
31 October 2026 / all dimensions mm / conditional body-motion comparison, not an installed renewal method
A Two bands; two roomward directions
Plan 1:25. One coupon at a time; both end assemblies removed.
Court band 417.5
Room 3415
Garden band 417.5
North / +Y →. Door apertures x4800–7200; axes x5800/6200.
Dashed old 650 strip: conditional receiving opening, not an existing hatch.
Brown: initial complete body. Green: after finite axial translation.
Court draw goes north/down; garden draw goes south/up.
B Which end must pass the bore?
Mechanism only; fitting axial sizes and end zones are unknown.
Trailing 220 must cross 160: rejected.
Leading 220 wholly outside may move away from the band.
Its complete extent and removal space remain unknown.
Removing a ring is not evidence that the trailing end is 108.
Numerical witness A uses a BARE 108 coupon, not this fitting.
Cutting/releasing both ends is a prerequisite, not simulated.
Fixed W2 must remain independent of the removed piece.
Calling an unrenewable service part “permanent” does not solve it.
C Historical 100 outstands: an explicit sensitivity
Axis-end span 617.5; complete inclined body 619.0.
First whole-body exit 518.3: contact, not working clearance.
Tip-only exit 517.5 leaves 0.762 of body in the band.
Finite witness: draw 619.0; vertical change 8.7 down/up.
Only after full exit, lift through the conditional open strip.
100 outstands and this chosen stroke are NOT selected allowances.
D What the geometric witness leaves open
Complete projections a/b and exit gap g must be actual inputs.
Room receipt: 417.5 + a + b + g ≤3415, before handling duties.
No installed support/skid/seal, tool or occupied-room fit is shown.
Both ends must be free; room modules must be removable first.
Rain diversion, fixed W2, dry access and reinstatement stay open.
No reduced exterior work area or hydraulic acceptance follows.
The continuous path is proved only for the stated bare body and empty receiving volume. No floor or threshold is redesigned.
Source: current house geometry + historical north comparison + RWT-METALS catalogue envelopes. RWT-06 remains incomplete.
Numerical precision is for reproducibility; it is not measured tolerance or evidence of physical maintenance clearance.
